name: Professor Emralla
description: A professor whose money and estate vanish from the records after Muzzio's constructs alter them.

timeline.summary: Muzzio's constructs erase Professor Emralla's money and registration of her estate, leaving her facing eviction.
timeline.quote: Professor Emralla found that the bank no longer had record of her money.
